### SUMMARY
The repo has 10 real test files, all directly under `tests/`; `tests/integration/` and `tests/unit/` contain only empty `__init__.py` stubs. Six files test the new `bot0_thought_graph` package (with `bot0_thought_graph.*` imports); four test legacy `src/` code via bare imports after `sys.path.append(src)` (mostly `agents.*`, `models.*`, `prompts.*`, `interviewagent_xf_edit_2`). 53 test functions total (59 pytest items due to one 7-way parametrization); zero `skip`/`skipif`/`xfail` markers. One test file (`test_question_loading.py`) is clearly outdated (hard-coded Windows paths, `os.chdir`, unittest-style); `test_question_generator_async.py` duplicates three tests from its integration twin and has debug prints.

**Package tests (`bot0_thought_graph.*` imports):**

- `tests/test_concept_first_api.py` (111 lines, 4 fns / 10 items): imports `ThoughtArray, ThoughtGraph, ThoughtGraphEngine` from `bot0_thought_graph` and `GenerationRequest, GenerationResult` from `bot0_thought_graph.providers` (lines 5-6). Fixture: `FakeProvider` dataclass with `responses: list[str]`, records `self.requests`, returns `GenerationResult(text, "fake", request.model)` (9-18). - `tests/test_thought_generation_package.py` (107 lines, 6 fns): imports from `bot0_thought_graph.models/.providers/.storage/.thought_generation` — `IdeaJSONModel`, `GenerationRequest/GenerationResult/ProviderRequestError`, `JsonRepository/MemoryRepository`, `HorizontalGenerationRequest/ThoughtGraphEngine/IndexedThoughtReader/ThoughtReader/VerticalGenerationRequest/extract_json/index_idea` (5-16).
